entities.name: MinE (86 aa sequence)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt B2FTA6 from Stenotrophomonas maltophilia; annotated as a cell-division topological specificity factor.
MinE domain PF03776.21 detected at residues 1–79; reference annotations associate it with cell division and regulation of division septum assembly.
Sequence-derived length 86 aa and estimated molecular mass 9.636 kDa; these estimates assume an unmodified protein.
